m1-predicate.title: Structural installed-bundle predicate replaces the name test
m1-predicate.imperative: In scripts/verify_iterative_role_artifacts.py add _is_skills_root(path) (parent carries CORPUS.json, or holds at least one constellation-*/ with its own SKILL.md) and _is_installed_bundle(path) (own SKILL.md AND parent is a skills root). Add tests named test_guard_location_predicate_* in tests/test_iterative_planning_doctrine.py that build the three location shapes as real directory trees under tempfile -- a real installed bundle, a main-checkout shape, a worktree shape -- plus a name-only decoy directory named constellation-* carrying no SKILL.md. Assert the predicate separates them and record the three observed columns (own SKILL.md, parent CORPUS.json, sibling count).

postconditions.statement: predicate decides by structure, not by name; three-location matrix and name-only decoy pass

m2-resolution.title: Resolution order, --skills-root flag, visible note, enumerating refusal
m2-resolution.imperative: Implement the four-step resolution order in _installed_skills_root(skills_root=None): explicit --skills-root wins (refuse if not a directory); else own bundle; else probe <cwd>/.claude/skills then ~/.claude/skills with a visible stderr note naming the root resolved; else REFUSE naming the real problem and every root tried. Add the --skills-root argparse flag and thread it through verify_explorer / verify_commander / verify_admiral_prelaunch. Add tests test_guard_location_resolution_* and test_guard_location_flag_* that shell out with an isolated HOME/USERPROFILE, assert the flag is reachable from all three modes, and assert the refusal enumerates the roots tried BY COUNT, not by eyeballing.

postconditions.statement: --skills-root wins when given and is reachable from all three modes; probe emits a visible stderr note; refusal names the real problem and every root tried (count asserted)

Paste both the green run and the red run as evidence. This is a non-overridable floor: if it cannot be made to fail on a broken input, STOP.

guard_mutation selector collects a nonzero count and passes

constraints: Do not widen the guard to make a check pass
